subject: Security kickoff: QSA/pen-test artifacts & vulnerability process — next steps
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Arjun Rao <arjun@medlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security kickoff: QSA/pen-test artifacts & vulnerability process — next steps

Hi Arjun,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciate the detailed questions from the Medlytics security team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- Redwood SOC 2 status: we completed SOC 2 Type II in 2025 (snapshot attached).
- Regulated scope: we recognize HIPAA as a requirement for your use case; we support BAAs and encryption-in-transit/at-rest.
- Vendor security questionnaire: I’ve attached our standard questionnaire template for your procurement team to review. If easier, feel free to send your questionnaire and we’ll map fields.
- Pen test artifacts: you asked for a summary of the most recent third-party penetration test, high-level findings, and our remediation SLAs. We can provide a redacted pen-test summary and our documented vulnerability management SLA.

Immediate asks / proposed owners:
1) Arjun — can you confirm the procurement doc we should populate (your vendor questionnaire or the template attached)?
2) Marcus (cc) — can you confirm which pen-test summary we can share (redacted) and expected turnaround to get it to Medlytics?
3) Irene (cc) — can you propose the remediation SLA table and recommended scanning cadence for HIPAA workloads?

Proposed timeline: we’ll send the redacted pen-test summary and remediation SLA by EOD tomorrow (Aug 4). Please confirm any NDAs or additional evidence (e.g. full report under an NDA) you’ll need.

Attachments: redwood_SOC2_type2_snapshot_2025.pdf, vendor-security-questionnaire_template.xlsx

Thanks — Vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0128

From: Arjun Rao <arjun@medlytics.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Liz Thompson <liz.thompson@medlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security kickoff: QSA/pen-test artifacts & vulnerability process — next steps

Vanessa — thanks for the recap and the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement: please use the attached Medlytics vendor questionnaire (I’ve CC'd Liz from procurement). If you can pre-fill the SOC2/attestation fields that speeds our review.
- Pen test: we primarily need a redacted executive summary (findings & remediation status) and a statement of scope (in-scope IPs, authenticated vs unauthenticated). Full report can be shared under an NDA if necessary.
- SLAs & cadence: our bar for HIPAA is 30-day remediation for critical vulnerabilities where we’re the impacted vendor, 90 days for high/medium agreed-upon exceptions. We’d like to see your proposed cadence (internal scans, external scans, pen test frequency).

Action: I’ve attached the Medlytics questionnaire filled out with a few placeholders. If Redwood can return the pre-filled questionnaire + redacted pen-test summary by EOD tomorrow that would keep our procurement timeline on schedule.

Thanks,
Arjun
Head of IT Risk, Medlytics
arjun@medlytics.com

Attachments: medlytics_filled_vendor_q_20260803.xlsx

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Medlytics vendor questionnaire + pen-test ask — need artifacts and SLAs

Team — forwarding Medlytics’ replies and their filled questionnaire (attached). Ask from procurement: redlined questionnaire + redacted pen-test summary + remediation SLA table by EOD tomorrow (Aug 4). Key constraints: they require a BAA conversation for HIPAA scope and are expecting 30-day critical SLAs.

Specifics I need from each of you: 
- Irene: confirm we can commit to 30-day critical SLA for vendor-reported issues where Redwood is responsible; propose scanning cadence (suggestion: weekly internal scans, monthly authenticated external scans, quarterly external unauthenticated scans, annual full pen test). Also draft the disclosure process (how we notify customers and timeline).
- Marcus: pull the latest pen-test executive summary (redacted) and scope statement. Confirm whether the vendor that ran the test contracts restrict distribution (if so we’ll send full report under NDA).
- Monica: help with procurement redlines and any MS/PS terms that should be surfaced (BAA routing).

I'll coordinate with Arjun on NDA if needed. If anyone can't meet the EOD tomorrow, please call out an alternative ETA within 24–48 hours.

Thanks — V

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Medlytics vendor questionnaire + pen-test ask — need artifacts and SLAs

Thanks Vanessa — outlining a short plan and what we can deliver by EOD today (Aug 4):

1) Artifacts we can provide tomorrow: 
   - redwood_pen_test_summary_redacted_2025.pdf (executive summary + scope details; third-party redaction applied)
   - redwood_SOC2_type2_snapshot_2025.pdf (attestation snapshot)
   - Vulnerability Management SLA (table) — draft: Critical = 30 days (target 14 where feasible), High = 90 days, Medium = 180 days; we’ll include exceptions handling and risk-acceptance workflow.

2) Proposed scanning cadence for HIPAA workloads:
   - Weekly internal authenticated scans (CI/CD pipeline + pre-prod)
   - Monthly authenticated external scans (Internet-facing assets)
   - Quarterly unauthenticated external scans (3rd party)
   - Annual full-scope penetration test (third-party)

3) Disclosure & remediation process (summary):
   - Triage within 24 hours of validated report
   - Initial customer notification within 72 hours for critical findings impacting production data flows
   - Public disclosure only after coordinated remediation plan or if legally required; vendor will provide redacted findings to customers for assurance.

4) NDA/Full report: Marcus — confirm whether we can release the full report under Redwood’s standard mutual NDA with the pen-test vendor’s consent. If the vendor restricts distribution we’ll route full report delivery under a tri-party NDA.

I’ll attach the three deliverables and upload SEC-4321 ticket with timelines. If procurement needs different SLA thresholds, we can iterate but want to preserve our operational commitments.

Irene
Director, Security Engineering | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
